reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and I can't tell from photos whether a paper cloud pendant is well made or looks cheap in person. I'd save it to a Pinterest board and move on, not spend $360 on a store I don't know.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and it's an unknown store where I'd pay return shipping on a big fragile fixture if it looks wrong.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap sample of the shade material, plus real customer photos and reviews from verified buyers, or free return shipping.
